Container.Name: Eidon
Container.Overview: All the big AI features, none of the lock-in. Eidon is an all-in-one agent platform that runs as a single Docker container on your server and works with your own key from any provider. It comes with all the bells and whistles already baked in for your chat and agents while syncing everything live between all of your devices.
Container.Requires: Before installing, generate the session and encryption secrets in the Unraid terminal with: openssl rand -hex 32 (run it twice, one value per field). Keep a copy of the encryption secret: restoring a backup needs the same value.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: ai assistant agent agents chat llm chatgpt openai anthropic claude ollama openrouter

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Your database, attachments, browser profiles and downloaded models. Back up this folder.

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: The address you open Eidon at, for example http://192.168.1.10:3000 or https://eidon.example.com. Used for share links and sign-in redirects.

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: Username of the first administrator account.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password of the first administrator account. At least 8 characters.

Config.Name: Session secret
Config.Description: Signs sign-in sessions. At least 32 characters: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Encryption secret
Config.Description: Encrypts stored provider keys. At least 32 characters: openssl rand -hex 32. Keep a copy: restoring a backup needs the same value.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID Eidon runs as and owns the Data folder with. 99 is Unraid's nobody user. Set together with PGID.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID Eidon runs as and owns the Data folder with. 100 is Unraid's users group. Set together with PUID.
